name: play_anim_frames
semantics: Play actor animation ANIM (state id = table 0x08072670[anim], identity table) frame by frame: each cel lasts FRAME_FRAMES frames, cels 0..LAST_FRAME; after the last cel restart at LOOP_START; LOOPS > 0 = number of passes (0 = forever). If WAIT != 0 the command completes when the passes are done (then the actor returns to idle, 0x0800EE78); if WAIT == 0 the command completes immediately and the animation keeps running.
evidence: controller update 0x0802CB05 read; emulator: (161,0,5,0,0,2,4) returned at once, (161,0,2,1,1,0,4) on an NPC never completed (anim has no cel 4); used e.g. script 329 on spawned sprite 89
